summary.name: LogoAI
summary.one_liner: LogoAI is an AI logo generator that creates logo concepts from a business name, description, or selected styles, and builds a brand kit around the chosen logo.
use_cases: Generating logo concepts for a new business
Refreshing or simplifying an existing logo
Turning a sketch or photo into a logo
Creating a handwritten signature logo for a personal brand
Building a brand kit with colors, fonts and matching graphics
Making assets for websites, business cards and social media
summary.what_it_does: LogoAI generates logo concepts from a business name, description and selected styles, exploring different symbols, lettering and compositions. Users can upload an existing logo to redesign it, upload a photo, sketch or drawing to convert it into a logo, or create a handwritten signature logo and compare variations side by side. Results are saved to one gallery. A chosen logo can be taken into the Brand Kit Studio to work with colors, fonts and matching graphics for websites, business cards and social media. The page also has an FAQ covering downloads, transparent backgrounds and usage rights, but the answers are not included in the page text.
notable: Four creation paths: business name, existing logo, image/sketch, or signature
Brand Kit Studio for colors, fonts and matching graphics
Comparison pages against Looka, Canva and Design.com
caveats: Pricing details and free-tier limits are not stated in the page text; the FAQ answers about free downloads, file formats and trademark are not included
Design.com comparison claims are the vendor's own characterization
